# DocWiz — Python dependencies (Python 3.10+)
# Install with:  pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# NOTE: no PyTorch / CUDA / NVIDIA packages are required. Embeddings are
# generated by a remote provider by default (Gemini free tier) — see
# .env.example. For fully local embeddings instead, see requirements-local.txt.

# Web framework
flask>=3.0

# .env file loading
python-dotenv>=1.0

# PDF text extraction (page-aware)
pymupdf>=1.24

# Vector math + index persistence
numpy>=1.26

# REST calls (Groq LLM + embedding provider)
requests>=2.31

# Tests (dev)
pytest>=8.0
